note: Dev tasks may be used to build the library and tune prompts. Held-out tasks must never be used for either.

dev.task: Move the Franka arm's gripper to the point 0.4 m in front of the base, 0.3 m up.
Reach a randomly placed target sphere on the table with the robot arm end effector.
Make the arm touch a marker floating above the table, marker position changes every run.
Pick up the cube and put it in the bin.
Grab the red block from the table and drop it into the box.
Use the arm to move the cube from its random start position into the bin.

heldout.task: Bring the arm tip to the coordinates shown by the target marker.
Position the end effector exactly at the target point, which is randomised each run.
Extend the robot arm so its hand reaches the highlighted point above the table.
Lift the cube and set it down inside the bin.
Pick the small block up off the table and place it in the container.
Transfer the cube from where it spawns into the bin using the gripper.

out_of_scope.task: Pick up a mug by its handle and pour it into a sink.
Make a quadruped robot walk across rough terrain to a goal.
Stack three cubes into a tower with the arm.
Design a new 7-DoF welding robot and have it trace a seam.
